After 1280◦C/30 min/AC + 950 ◦C/6 h/FC heat treatment, the yield strength of TiAlMn alloy increases gradually with the testing temperature, then signiﬁcantly drops from 605 MPa to 469 MPa in the temperature range of 650 ◦C–700◦C.

After 1230◦C/1 h/AC + 850◦C/6 h/FC heat treatment, the yield strength of TNM alloy decreases gradually with the increasing testing temperature, and remarkably drops from 498 MPa to 440 MPa between 700◦C and 750◦C.
